item.title: Why was Jimi Hendrix so big in the 90s? - The FIZZ Radio
item.description: Jimi Hendrix experienced a massive resurgence in the 1990s, from iconic movie cameos in Wayne’s World to his profound influence on the Seattle grunge scene. Explore how his mastery of feedback and distortion shaped the sound of a new generation and why his Electric Lady Studios remains a sanctuary for modern legends.

item.title: Phil Collins is overdue for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame - The FIZZ Radio
item.description: Here's why Phil Collins is overdue for a solo induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. From inventing the iconic gated reverb sound with Peter Gabriel to his legendary drum duets with Chester Thompson, discover the virtuoso talent that defined the 80s. Join the fan vote to help Phil Collins take his rightful place in the 2026 induction class.
